params.body:
The closing "Got an idea? Let's make it tangible!" band sat close under its divider: 32 px on Home, the case pages and the blog article, 16 px on About and Our approach.

Every variant with a divider now uses one value, `clamp(24px, 3.75vw, 48px)`: 48 px on desktop, 24 px at 390 px. The Cases overview, whose band has no divider, is unchanged.

Measured in a browser on six pages at 1280 and 390 px, before (live) and after (local build on the production dataset).
params.title: More room above the closing call to action
